output.reason: The troubleshooting note [ev-0eb3d16492e3] gives only an error message and a workaround: use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0. It does not say which field or setting changed, or what caused the Forbidden error. The rendered diffs (e.g. [ev-558ba9e85f76], [ev-7a082965d61c]) show the chart's webhook-based spec.conversion block removed from about 20 CRD manifests. However, no upstream text links that removal to this error, so treating it as the subject and change would be a guess. The proposed subject is also a poor fit for the crd-field family: CustomResourceDefinition is the Kubernetes CRD object itself, not a custom resource the product defines. To decide, we need upstream text (a fix PR, issue or upgrade guide) that names the change in 0.16.0 that causes this error.
